title: The named generation-4 body of the low-noise layered CIPS claim (seed 0, track 22) dies within 50 t when an absorbing moat cuts its own fuel, while the fed twin keeps it and all 16 other bodies stay
summary: Follow-up to 20261026T1626-c44-cips-lownoise-gen4-claim, whose E control cut four other bodies. Same world (seed 0), re-run to t=25000 (the labkit pack's final state), then a fed twin and one moat arm per named body, located at labkit's final centroid: track 22 (generation 4, the claim's track; (54.5, 51.7), 205 px) and track 11 (generation 2; (138.2, 145.2), 173 px). Moat: kF=0 in a disk of 0.6x the nearest-neighbour distance (24-26 px) plus F=0 in the annulus from 16 px to that radius. Track 22: 205 -> 20 px at t=25025 and 0 at t=25050; track 11: 0 at t=25025. In both arms the other named body keeps its fed size (200 and 173 px) and the 16 bodies outside the disk stay to t=25975; the fed twin keeps all 17.

finding.operator: local fuel cut with an absorbing moat around a named labkit track
finding.control: fed twin and the other named body, branched from the same t=25000 state of seed 0
finding.result: track 22 (generation 4) and track 11 dead by t=25050 and t=25025; fed twin and 16 outside bodies kept

limits: One seed, two named bodies, one moat geometry; the moat is an imposed fuel sink. Run with: CUT_AT="54.5,51.7;138.2,145.2" python cutmany.py 0 25000 1000 gen4cut_s0 0.6 2 16.
